# Alico to Present at the 16th Annual East Coast IDEAS Investor Conference


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_ed4de0deb93c6ad8943395ea758419d0/alicoinc/news/2026-05-27_Alico_to_Present_at_the_16th_Annual_East_Coast_1460.pdf) May 27, 2026


FORT MYERS, Fla., May 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alico, Inc. (“Alico” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: ALCO) today announced that John Kiernan, the Company’s President and Chief Executive Officer, will present and host one-on-one meetings with investors at the 16th Annual East Coast IDEAS Investor Conference at The Westin TimesSquare in New York, NY on June 10-11, 2026.


The presentation will begin at 2:40 PM Eastern Time on Wednesday, June 10th. Management will also host one-on-one meetings with investors on Wednesday, June 10th. The presentation will be webcast live and can be accessed through the conference host’s main website:[https://www.threepartadvisors.com/east-coast](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=9gXEOQF3pDQh0idWctNPOIXNya-AYqsx2f93OIe-lUL62Yf9FWg4iNKy9yMc78S8K2yFWOCg7WGokwHG52VmzhPqy2uFTVJiNBemt1hHFaymGbhm6xpGIZsStnCsEqquPL0ewZ9bvI2I2DxSCjLHb49XogEBOOH_xfKOdGu_vM8=) and can be accessed through the “News / Events” tab on the investor relations website at[https://ir.alicoinc.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=9gXEOQF3pDQh0idWctNPOKdmt7lwN78RFQxoRhy5TCTHYkiSOtn8KiEraY418I9yad26dwddo6hi4mwvVa3qMjP6NtSoN7RJS_iw460Wl_4G3GnTlZ4Chre8lxuH8YUHKN6bSn6DMM-8539Zj3Ma_W8jRflHr8xh_e4HI-AAciZrXb3CYKIKWXyHOGae4anze5g20dOhlBWdk4mwmEArNM_8Ixn4uwrqa5dz3balsQ54DLnales6tqNukXDvLItMEzZ5gP58611dFe-IO4yzyIQAOpnLHaP_NOuiT1E40aA2qQRyUi9XFNrcdmpz7pGbNb6w9Q7GBeQ-oFkvAa8BZclpkKrPS1Dgl1Pv9wKf_ryHP73Bo3O0yJ4fGSywzJN0kVbw_WID5-zJ_eStzH9QQaFDM3GgEEo0q-gscmtMEuYIIBOJHedT8CW-Z-5jmGVu7quzEgxce8MLX_H3u-rQ4EvBcesnDzv1pV62XlOgf-rI09M5YKlkUrJ_2UOnT9xk) .


**About Alico**


Alico, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALCO) is a Florida-based agribusiness and land management company with over 125 years of experience. Following its strategic transformation in 2025, Alico operates as a diversified land company with approximately 46,000 acres across 7 Florida counties. The Company focuses on strategic land development opportunities and diversified agricultural operations, leveraging its extensive land portfolio to create long-term shareholder value while maintaining its commitment to responsible land stewardship and conservation. Learn more about Alico at[www.alicoinc.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=eNB9zTwCbexGggubmbH-eLsw2Ii7NgOJUoujRfy9T3cCLj_wLlEfJMm7VwppTpkGWMffQhrgddKgbfqlMJL1yfyBmQGKfpvZndUvIr_yN1c=) .
